facts.fact: Icilome reports that service note 082/MEPSTA/CAB/SG of 2 August 2021 from the minister of primary, secondary and technical education instructs CNDP-TICE to create a single platform for managing pupils' marks for all public and private schools, consultable at every level of the system; the platform is ordered, not built, and no school is said to use it.
facts.system: plateforme unique de gestion de notes

facts.fact: The minister's service note of 2 August 2021 gives the building of the marks platform to the ministry's own Centre national de documentation pédagogique et des technologies de l'information et de la communication pour l'éducation (CNDP-TICE).
facts.system: plateforme unique de gestion de notes

systems.owner: CNDP-TICE, Ministère des Enseignements primaire, secondaire, technique et de l'Artisanat
systems.tiers: intended for all public and private schools; consultable at all levels

systems.system: yearly centralised list of pupils with final results
systems.tiers: all public schools, and private schools through each regional director

note: Classed emis on the stated purpose, a record of each pupil's marks; the article says nothing of who would enter them or when. The note names no level beyond all schools under a ministry covering primary and secondary, so no levels fact is taken. The yearly list of pupils with final results is ordered to be centralised with no medium stated.
